en.joke: My phone just asked if I wanted to "enhance" a screenshot of my blank calendar. What's next, "decluttering" my digital dust?
en.explanation: It's funny because it exaggerates AI's tendency to offer irrelevant "optimizations" for trivial digital items, highlighting modern life's over-optimization.

people.name: Fran Zwitter
people.extract: Fran Zwitter was a Slovenian historian. Together with Milko Kos, Bogo Grafenauer, and Vasilij Melik, he is considered the co-founder of the Ljubljana School of Historiography.
highlights: Co-founder of Ljubljana School of Historiography.

people.name: Adrienne Bailon-Houghton
people.bio: American singer, actress, and television personality
people.extract: Adrienne Eliza Bailon-Houghton ; born October 24, 1983) is an American television personality, singer, and actress. She was a former member of the girl groups 3LW and The Cheetah Girls. From 2013 to 2022, Bailon co-hosted The Real. For her work on The Real, she became the first Latina host of a daytime talk show in the United States, and earned a Daytime Emmy Award. She also had a stint as co-anchor of the entertainment news show, E! News.
highlights: Member of girl groups 3LW and The Cheetah Girls.
First Latina host of a US daytime talk show.
